research_scope: UK/Irish racing only; previous named title-edition candidates first; fallback same course/type/class/surface/distance within 1f, five years
selection_policy: Frozen probability thresholds (A/B), historical positive evidence, and top-vs-second gap. Conditional-gate results are PROXY research gates, not historical replays of live Stage13 exact-event selection rules.
source_limits: Historical results in this actual input database span 1988-01-01 to 2026-11-10; older named-event identities are used only where their underlying race results exist. Published Model A coefficients may have been trained on a different Stage2 artifact; replay uses the frozen model.
